# Review backend API integration steps (2025-08-09 18:53Z)

_**User (2025-08-08 20:28Z)**_

@Arzansite backend https://nest.arzansite.com/api please review backend:
Do NOT call any Supabase Admin endpoints from the browser api.arzansite.com. Never expose the service role key client-side.
Replace direct Supabase signup with backend calls:
Sign up: call POST /api/auth/signup
Verify: your email link redirects to FRONTEND_URL/verify-email?token=...; your page should call POST /api/auth/verify-email with the token
Login: call POST /api/auth/login; store access_token and refresh_token
Forgot password: call POST /api/auth/forgot-password
Reset password: the recovery link lands on FRONTEND_URL/reset-password?code=.... For self-hosted Supabase, the simplest is to use the browser Supabase client with the anon key just for this step:
1) supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession() with the code from URL (gets a temp session)
2) supabase.auth.updateUser({ password: 'newPass' })
Alternatively, I can add a backend endpoint to complete the reset server-side if you prefer to avoid Supabase client on the frontend.

Yes — that error is coming from the backend’s auth policy, not the frontend.

Likely causes on the backend
- Signup disabled: Supabase “Allow new users to sign up” is off, or Nest has a SIGNUPS_ENABLED flag disabled.
- Domain allowlist/invite-only: Backend or Supabase requires invite code or restricts email domains.
- CAPTCHA required: Backend expects a recaptcha token you’re not sending.
- Site mode restriction: Backend blocks signup when site is in maintenance/update mode.

Quick checks
- Ensure frontend base URL is correct:
  - Set `VITE_API_URL=https://nest.arzansite.com/api`
- Try a direct POST to see the full backend error:
  - PowerShell:
    ```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://nest.arzansite.com/api/auth/signup' -Headers @{'Content-Type'='application/json'} -Body (@{ email='you@example.com'; password='Test1234!'; metadata=@{} } | ConvertTo-Json)
    ```
- Verify backend config:
  - Supabase Dashboard → Auth → Email: “Allow new users to sign up” ON; remove domain allowlist if not intended.
  - Nest env: look for flags like `AUTH_SIGNUPS_ENABLED`, `ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS`, `REQUIRE_INVITE_CODE`, `RECAPTCHA_SECRET` and adjust.
  - Check site mode via GET `/api/site-config/current`; ensure it’s not in `temporarily_unavailable` or `update_mode`.
- If using CAPTCHA, update the signup form to send the token to `/api/auth/signup`.

If you share the backend’s exact response body (besides the wrapped message) or env flags, I’ll pinpoint which check is failing and adjust the frontend request accordingly.

- Changes I made earlier already switch signup to POST `/api/auth/signup`; the frontend is fine. This specific error is a backend rule rejecting the user.

- Summary
  - The error “User not allowed” is backend-driven.
  - Check Supabase signup setting, domain allowlist/invite-only, CAPTCHA requirement, and site mode.
  - Confirm `VITE_API_URL` is set; test the endpoint directly to view detailed backend error.
